title: ‘Standing on one leg’: IMF chief warns about global economy as AI circular financing hits $1 trillion
summary_full: Kristalina Georgieva says circular financing among AI companies has grown to just over $1 trillion, two-thirds of it debt, as investor enthusiasm cools
summary_public: Kristalina Georgieva says circular financing among AI companies has grown to just over $1 trillion, two-thirds of it debt, as investor enthusiasm cools
